text: Write the polymorphic loop that replaces a chain of type tests. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: record Circle(double r) implements Shape { public double area() { return ___; } }
record Square(double s) implements Shape { public double area() { return s * s; } }
Shape[] shapes = { new Circle(1), new Square(2) };
explanation: Verified: 3.1416 then 4.0000. The loop asks nothing about which shape it has, which means adding a triangle touches one new file and leaves the loop alone. The alternative — an `instanceof` chain — collects every area in one place, away from the data each uses, and the compiler cannot tell you when you have missed a case.
